name: LimeSurvey
description: LimeSurvey is an open-source research platform for building and running online surveys. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys LimeSurvey as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Platform for building online surveys. Deploy LimeSurvey with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
